answer: An agent network deters Sybil attacks via ambient acoustic multilateration. Nodes in a field of yarrow verify spatial claims by cross-correlating acoustic transients, such as the call of a raven, across peer receivers. Forging identities demands discrete physical microphones across distinct coordinates, imposing real hardware and deployment costs per node. However, thermal drift in quartz oscillators can desynchronize arrival timestamps, causing occasional false rejections.
